title: Address-resolution API endpoint: NYC address to canonical address + BBL with source_fact provenance, over the internal flag-gated API
objective: Expose the accepted M2-T021 Geoclient connector as GET /api/v1/address-resolution (house_number + street + borough-or-zip query params), flag-gated internal-only exactly like the sibling routes: call resolve_address with the environment key at call time (key never in config, logs, errors, or the response), transport the TYPED outcome honestly - resolved (canonical address, bbl, bin, coordinates, both GRCs), ambiguous (the source's suggestion list VERBATIM, selection always the caller's), not_found/rejected (visible outcome with both GRCs and messages, never silence), and typed failures (key-missing/auth/rate-limit/unavailable/malformed mapped to bounded HTTP payloads) - and discharge the MVP_AGENDA C4 endpoint duties: the resolved outcome's material facts (bbl, bin, canonical address fields, coordinates) are ADDITIONALLY emitted as source_fact-shaped records validating against packages/contracts/schemas/v1/source_fact.schema.json (READ-ONLY use of the existing schema - proving consumability, never forking a contract); the response documents grc_message/grc2_message/suggestions/raw-derived text as UNSANITIZED reflected input consumers must escape on render; no AnalysisBudget analysis_id is ever derived from request input. In-module contract version + response shape per the evidence.py house pattern; correlation id on every response and log line; NO UI in this packet (the confirm-screen/address-entry UI packet follows).
business_reason: Address entry is the top client-demo item on the owner working list (docs/MVP_AGENDA.md B3 / A2 row 4): users type a street address instead of a ten-digit BBL. The connector (M2-T021, accepted 178th) resolves addresses but nothing serves it over the API; this endpoint is the missing middle between the connector and the address-entry UI, and it must prove the AddressResolution-to-source_fact mapping the C4 carry-forward owes.
inputs: services/api/app/connectors/geoclient_address.py (the accepted M2-T021 connector: resolve_address signature, AddressResolution contract incl. the three honesty rules, typed error taxonomy, reflected-input caution)
services/api/tests/fixtures/geoclient/G01_address_documented_example.json, G02_address_ambiguous_ee.json, G03_address_rejected_42.json (recorded fixtures; offline test bodies)
docs/research/source-registry-drafts/geoclient.json (registry record: status model, response_semantics honesty rules, reflected_input_warning)
docs/MVP_AGENDA.md section C4 (the endpoint duties this packet discharges: source_fact mapping + consumability proof, escape-reflected-text, analysis_id never from untrusted input)
packages/contracts/schemas/v1/source_fact.schema.json (READ-ONLY: the contract the emitted facts must validate against)
services/api/app/api/v1/evidence.py + services/api/tests/api/test_evidence_api.py (the house endpoint pattern: flag gating, in-module contract version, correlation id, dependency-override test seams)

acceptance_scenarios.input: GET the endpoint for the G01 address (314 / w 100 st / manhattan) with the connector's transport dependency-overridden to replay the recorded G01 body and a sentinel key in the (monkeypatched) environment
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 200; status 'resolved'; bbl/bin/canonical street/zip/coordinates equal values LOADED FROM THE FIXTURE (never restated as literals - M5-T004 rule); both GRCs and both messages present; a source_facts[] array whose every record VALIDATES against packages/contracts/schemas/v1/source_fact.schema.json (jsonschema in-test) and whose values are byte-equal to the outcome fields; provenance carries source id, endpoint, key-free request params, retrieval timestamp, response digest + canonicalization, correlation id; the response's correlation id equals the X-Correlation-ID header

acceptance_scenarios.input: the recorded G02 (EE) body through the same seam
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 200; status 'ambiguous'; the suggestion list VERBATIM from the fixture in source slot order; NO source_facts emitted (no material fact exists until a human selects); no bbl fabricated; a machine-readable field states selection is the caller's decision

acceptance_scenarios.input: the recorded G03 (42) body; plus a CONSTRUCTED not_found (11/11) variant clearly labeled
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 200 with a VISIBLE typed status (rejected / not_found), both GRCs + reason codes + messages transported, partial fields (e.g. normalized street) transported per the connector's populated-on-non-resolved contract, NO source_facts; never a silent empty 200, never a 5xx for a legitimate geocoding outcome

acceptance_scenarios.input: seams raising KeyMissingError, AuthFailedError, RateLimitedError (with retry_after), SourceUnavailableError, SourceTimeoutError, MalformedResponseError, InvalidInputError (oversized/mistyped params), RequestBudgetExceededError
acceptance_scenarios.expected: each maps to a documented (status_code, error payload) pair - invalid input 422-class, key-missing/auth 502/503-class (the CLIENT is never blamed for a server-side key problem), rate-limited surfaces a bounded retry-after value, malformed/unavailable 502/503-class; every payload bounded, correlation id present, THE KEY VALUE IN NO PAYLOAD OR LOG (leak-absence harvest with positive controls across every failure path, pluto/geoclient test pattern); no upstream body text passes through unsanitized

acceptance_scenarios.input: the endpoint with the internal flag unset; then set
acceptance_scenarios.expected: unset: the route is absent/404s exactly like the sibling internal routes' gating behavior; set: serves. A test asserts the gating env var name follows the existing internal-route convention

acceptance_scenarios.input: the G02 response (whose message echoes the typed street) plus a CONSTRUCTED variant whose message/suggestion carries HTML/script-looking text
acceptance_scenarios.expected: the endpoint transports the text VERBATIM in the JSON body (transport, never interpret) AND the response carries the machine-readable unsanitized-reflected-input warning (C4 duty) naming the affected fields; the test asserts the hostile text arrives byte-exact (JSON-encoded) and appears in no log line or header

acceptance_scenarios.input: the full test module with the module-wide socket guard (connector test pattern)
acceptance_scenarios.expected: every test runs offline through injected seams; no real key read (sentinel + positive control); the endpoint holds no state and no cache; two identical requests produce two connector calls with distinct correlation ids

acceptance_scenarios.input: source reading + a test asserting the endpoint's connector call
acceptance_scenarios.expected: the endpoint never constructs an AnalysisBudget from ANY request-derived value (C4: analysis_id never from untrusted input) - either no budget is passed, or a server-authored constant identity is used; a test pins the call signature

risks: Key leakage through a new HTTP surface: S4's leak-absence harvest with positive controls is the control; the connector's own hygiene is necessary but not sufficient once HTTP error handlers exist.
Fabricating a selection on ambiguity: S2 pins that suggestions transport verbatim and no fact is emitted until a human chooses.
Contract drift disguised as mapping: source_facts must validate against the EXISTING schema and stay byte-equal to outcome fields (S1).
path_notes: EXACT-FILE allowed_paths per the M5-T013 endpoint template: one new route module, main.py for router registration ONLY, one new test module, the producer report. packages/contracts/** is FORBIDDEN: source_fact.schema.json is consumed READ-ONLY (validated against in tests), never edited - the C4 duty is proving the mapping onto the EXISTING contract.

The whole-suite documented command exists because of the M4-T009 lesson: a packet-local suite can be green while sibling consumers break; run services/api/tests (minus the 3.12-only documents modules locally; CI runs them) before submit.

The subscription key exists in exactly two places (owner machine env; Render dashboard) and must never appear in any file, response, header, or log; the endpoint reads it only via the connector's own call-time env read.
